method: First pregame Kalshi quote per contract and side; settled contract result; no postgame feature backfill. Lower Brier/log loss is better. Market-only rows are identical by design. Gross positive-EV return excludes fees and is not a placed-bet ledger. NFL totals use final ESPN score when available.
